title: PROSPER: LLMs as Sparse Retrievers for First-Stage Product Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.28645v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Product search is a crucial component of large-scale e-commerce platforms, where first-stage retrieval should achieve high recall while ensuring efficient online deployment. Sparse retrieval remains attractive for this setting due to its interpretability and deployability, yet it suffers from severe vocabulary mismatch challenges, especially for short queries and product titles. Large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic capabilities, but directly applying them to sparse retrieval in product search introduces new challenges: (i) semantic expansion may distort critical literal signals such as brand names and model identifiers; and (ii) learning meaningful sparse representations is difficult in the high-dimensional vocabulary space induced by LLMs.To address these challenges, we propose PROSPER, a framework that uses LLMs as sparse retrievers for product search while explicitly preserving lexical fidelity. translated_title: PROSPER：将大语言模型用作第一阶段商品搜索的稀疏检索器
translated_abstract: 商品搜索是大规模电子商务平台的关键组成部分，其第一阶段检索需要在确保高效在线部署的同时实现高召回率。稀疏检索因其可解释性和可部署性在该场景下仍极具吸引力，但它面临严重的词汇不匹配挑战，尤其是对于短查询和商品标题。大语言模型（LLM）具备强大的语义能力，但将其直接应用于商品搜索的稀疏检索会带来新的挑战：（i）语义扩展可能扭曲品牌名称和型号标识符等关键的字面信号；（ii）在LLM所诱导的高维词表空间中学习有意义的稀疏表示十分困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了PROSPER，一个将LLM用作商品搜索稀疏检索器、同时显式保持词汇保真度的框架。PROSPER 结合了（i）一个……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出PROSPER框架，将大语言模型用作商品搜索第一阶段的稀疏检索器，在利用其语义扩展能力的同时显式保持品牌名、型号等字面信号的词汇保真度。
en_tdlr: PROSPER is a framework that leverages LLMs as sparse retrievers for first-stage product search, explicitly preserving lexical fidelity to overcome semantic distortion of literal signals and the difficulty of learning meaningful sparse representations in LLM-induced high-dimensional vocabulary spaces.
